title: Bottom Signals, AI Purge, Bitcoin Stands Alone
script_summary:
**ORACLE BRIEF**

Bitcoin just sat still while the entire market burned — and that silence is the loudest signal of the week.

Three macro lows across five years just printed a parallel channel — the cleanest structural setup in Bitcoin's chart history. That's not pattern-matching. That's geometry. Eighty-five thousand is not a prediction — it's what the channel says happens next.

But here's what matters: while gold tanked, oil spiked nineteen percent, and equities collapsed, Bitcoin held sixty
